chunks: 4 – Al-Ḥasan ibn Ḥudhayfa (ibn al-Manṣūr), the Kufan, from Hamdān, the Sābirī vendor. Very weak. No benefit can be taken from him.

key_terms.بَيَّاعُ السَّابِرِيِّ: The Sābirī vendor (a specific trade or location identifier for the narrator)
key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ جِدًّا: Very weak (a technical term in hadith criticism indicating low reliability)
key_terms.لَا يُرْتَفَعُ بِهِ: No benefit can be taken from him / He is not elevated (meaning his narration is not considered sound enough to be used as evidence)

ai.seo_question: Who is al-Hasan ibn Hudhayfa and what is his status in hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the book *Kitab al-Du'afa* (Book of the Weak Narrators) concerning al-asan ibn Hudhayfa. It describes his origin, profession, and evaluates his reliability in hadith transmission as 'very weak,' meaning his narrations are not elevated or accepted as sound.
